Name: Classic Fluffy Pancakes
Ingredients:
1 cup flour
2 tbsp sugar
2 tsp baking powder
1 cup milk
1 egg
2 tbsp melted butter
Instruction:
Whisk dry ingredients together in a bowl.
Whisk milk, egg, and melted butter in a separate bowl.
Combine wet and dry ingredients until just mixed.
Pour batter onto a hot greased griddle.
Flip when bubbles appear on the surface and cook until golden.
Equipment: Mixing bowls, Whisk, Griddle or non-stick pan, Spatula

Name: Avocado & Poached Egg Toast
Ingredients:
2 slices sourdough bread
1 ripe avocado
2 fresh eggs
1 tbsp lemon juice
1 tsp chili flakes
Salt and black pepper
Instruction:
Toast sourdough slices until golden and crisp.
Mash avocado with lemon juice, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Bring a small pot of water to a gentle simmer with a splash of vinegar.
Poach eggs for 3 minutes until whites are set but yolks are runny.
Spread avocado over toast, top with poached eggs, and sprinkle with chili flakes.
Equipment: Toaster, Small pot, Slotted spoon, Fork

Name: Creamy Garlic Alfredo Pasta
Ingredients:
8 oz fettuccine pasta
2 tbsp butter
3 cloves garlic minced
1 cup heavy cream
1 cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese
Salt and black pepper
Instruction:
Boil fettuccine according to package instructions and drain.
Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat and sauté minced garlic for 1 minute.
Pour in heavy cream and bring to a simmer.
Stir in Parmesan cheese until sauce is smooth.
Toss cooked pasta in the Alfredo sauce and season with salt and pepper.
Equipment: Large pot, Colander, Skillet or saucepan, Tongs

Name: Grilled Chicken Caesar Salad Wrap
Ingredients:
2 large flour tortillas
1 cup grilled chicken breast sliced
2 cups chopped Romaine lettuce
1/4 cup Caesar dressing
1/4 cup grated Parmesan cheese
1/2 cup croutons crushed
Instruction:
In a large bowl, toss Romaine lettuce, chicken, croutons, and Parmesan with Caesar dressing.
Warm flour tortillas in a dry skillet for 10 seconds per side.
Divide the salad mixture evenly between tortillas.
Fold in the sides of each tortilla and roll tightly into a wrap.
Equipment: Large bowl, Skillet, Chef knife, Cutting board

Name: Pan-Seared Garlic Butter Steak
Ingredients:
2 ribeye steaks
2 tbsp olive oil
3 tbsp butter
4 cloves garlic smashed
3 sprigs fresh rosemary
Coarse salt and black pepper
Instruction:
Generously season steaks with salt and pepper on all sides.
Heat olive oil in a heavy skillet over high heat until smoking.
Add steaks and sear for 3 to 4 minutes without moving.
Flip steaks and add butter, smashed garlic, and rosemary to the pan.
Spoon melted butter repeatedly over steaks while cooking for another 3 minutes.
Remove from heat and rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
Equipment: Cast iron skillet, Spoon, Tongs, Cutting board

Name: Teriyaki Salmon Rice Bowl
Ingredients:
2 salmon fillets
1/4 cup soy sauce
2 tbsp honey
1 tbsp mirin
1 tsp minced ginger
2 cups cooked jasmine rice
1/2 cup steamed broccoli
Instruction:
Whisk soy sauce, honey, mirin, and minced ginger in a small saucepan over low heat until thickened into a glaze.
Heat oil in a pan over medium-high heat and sear salmon skin-side down for 4 minutes.
Flip salmon and cook for another 3 minutes, brushing liberally with teriyaki glaze.
Serve glazed salmon over warm jasmine rice with a side of steamed broccoli.

Name: Loaded Guacamole with Chips
Ingredients:
3 ripe avocados
1/2 diced red onion
1 diced Roma tomato
1/4 cup chopped cilantro
1 lime juiced
1/2 tsp salt
Tortilla chips
Instruction:
Halve, seed, and scoop avocado flesh into a bowl.
Mash avocados coarsely with a fork.
Fold in red onion, tomato, cilantro, lime juice, and salt.
Serve immediately alongside tortilla chips.
Equipment: Mixing bowl, Fork, Chef knife, Cutting board

Name: Crispy Air-Fryer Chickpeas
Ingredients:
1 can (15 oz) chickpeas rinsed and drained
1 tbsp olive oil
1/2 tsp smoked paprika
1/2 tsp garlic powder
1/2 tsp cumin
1/2 tsp salt
Instruction:
Pat chickpeas completely dry using paper towels.
Toss chickpeas in olive oil, paprika, garlic powder, cumin, and salt.
Transfer to the air fryer basket and spread in a single layer.
Air fry at 390°F (200°C) for 15 minutes, shaking the basket halfway through until crunchy.
Equipment: Air fryer, Paper towels, Mixing bowl

Name: Fudgy Chocolate Mug Cake
Ingredients:
4 tbsp all-purpose flour
2 tbsp cocoa powder
2 tbsp sugar
3 tbsp milk
1 tbsp melted butter
1 tbsp chocolate chips
Instruction:
Whisk flour, cocoa powder, and sugar together inside a microwave-safe mug.
Add milk and melted butter, stirring with a fork until smooth.
Drop chocolate chips into the center of the batter.
Microwave on high for 60 seconds.
Let cool for 2 minutes before serving.

Name: Classic Berry Fruit Crisp
Ingredients:
4 cups mixed berries (fresh or frozen)
2 tbsp sugar
1 tbsp cornstarch
1 cup rolled oats
1/2 cup flour
1/4 cup brown sugar
1/4 cup cold butter cubed
Instruction:
Toss mixed berries, sugar, and cornstarch together and pour into a baking dish.
In a bowl, mix oats, flour, and brown sugar.
Cut in cold cubed butter using a pastry cutter or fingertips until crumbly.
Spread oat topping evenly over the berries.
Bake at 350°F (175°C) for 30 minutes until fruit is bubbly and topping is golden brown.
Equipment: Baking dish, Mixing bowl, Pastry cutter
